Vine & Lincoln Residences

Washer/dryer in-unit. Dishwasher. Reserved covered parking included. Built 2021.
Water, sewer & trash billed back by Conservice, approximately $60/month. Tenant pays electric directly to the utility; gas for cooking.
Typical electric bill: $55.
Pets: No pets.
Application fee $40; Admin fee $100. Security deposit $750.
